questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this Brent long lost 1R: it went through 98.0 first, as random entries with your target and stop did 38.3% of the time. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck.

Zweig: beware following the crowd. The idea's source is consensus, yet managed money sits only at the 17.0th percentile on your side: is this your own view or the consensus story, and what would you need to see to know the crowd is right this time?
